evals.prompt: My note 'Home Garden Log.md' has become a mess: tomato, irrigation and compost notes are scattered all over it. Split it into a few topic notes (keep the original file as an index) so things are grouped. The vault is the folder evals/files/sample-vault. Do not rewrite or clean up my text, and prove nothing got lost.
evals.expected_output: Topic notes for tomatoes, irrigation and composting, each gathering its scattered sections; 'Home Garden Log.md' becomes an index; every original line appears exactly once, verbatim; links to moved headings (inside the notes and in 'Weekend Plans.md') point at the new notes; a verification result is reported.
expectations: Every non-blank line of the original appears in the topic notes (nothing lost)
No original line appears more than once across the topic notes (nothing duplicated)
The bash code block is byte-identical in one topic note
The Wi-Fi password line is kept verbatim (not redacted)
All scattered tomato sections land in the same note
All scattered irrigation sections land in the same note
All scattered composting sections land in the same note
Home Garden Log.md still exists and links to every topic note (index)
Weekend Plans heading link now targets the note that holds 'Drip line layout'
Weekend Plans markdown heading link now targets the note that holds 'Composting'
Weekend Plans bare link [[Home Garden Log]] kept (points at the index)
The tomato problem link to 'Drip line layout' resolves after the split
